C.text: attention head 1 lambda=0.02 (sigma=5 cells) and source-neutral; head 0 unchanged

D.text: priority selection maps xavier_uniform(gain=.5), zero bias

lineage.comparator: C_t is concat_heads(sum_j A_t,h,i,j V_t,h,j) before W_O; the learned Conv([R_t-1,H_t]) comparator is absent.
